behaviour_differences: Design::new now also refuses a repeated component INSTANCE id (SCIN) and a repeated PAINT STYLE id (SSTY) with Duplicate(<id>): Folio's pass covers both namespaces, the old components index did not key by them (a repeated SCIN made validate_with_instance replace only the first record). Test: design_refuses_repeated_ids (instance case). Paint styles are covered by the Folio test only (the components fixture has none).

Detection order when several repeats exist at once: document nodes, design entries, components then sets (id, then container layer), collections, variables, then the NEW instances and paint styles. Every repeat the old code refused is refused with the same Duplicate(id) and in the same relative order; only inputs whose sole repeat is an instance or paint style id changed from accepted to refused.
VariableTable::new (public) keeps its outcomes and now calls check_variable_identity_uniqueness; Design builds its lookup with the crate-private VariableTable::index after the full pass.

Folio validators (validate_document, validate_design_records) are unchanged in outcome and order: they claim ids through the same Namespaces at the same points; the old per-function unique() helper in records.rs and the nodes.insert(...).is_some() checks in lib.rs are gone.
